It must validate the complete installed inventory, exit successfully and report the exact file URL of the pinned installed HTML. The URL must resolve to the declared regular HTML file within the new installation, with correct path encoding. Verify its identity independently against the frozen 64,651-byte HTML. Record exact child stdout/stderr separately from outer-shell initialization warnings. A timeout, incomplete capture, unknown child status, or missing hash is not success. Preserve the first failure and reconcile it; do not silently repeat the same installation or browser work to replace evidence.
